adjudication.rationale: The diff shows client-side validation in `AddGuestsDialog` only enforces (a) email format and (b) uniqueness within the submitted array via `new Set(emails)` (lines ~26-29), but it does not validate against existing booking attendees. On the server, `addGuestsHandler` filters out emails already in `booking.attendees` (and blacklisted ones) and proceeds without reporting which inputs were dropped, only throwing if *all* are filtered out (`uniqueGuests.length === 0`). This creates divergent semantics: a user can submit an email already on the booking, pass client validation, get a success toast, yet that specific email is silently ignored server-side (partial no-op with no per-guest feedback).
